name: Blameless Incident Post-Mortem Workflow
description: Reads an incident timeline and produces a blameless post-mortem report by extracting events, analyzing contributing factors and customer impact in parallel, then merging into a final report with action items.

agents.description: Reads the incident timeline and extracts a structured, chronological sequence of events (timestamps, actors, actions, system states).
Analyzes the extracted event sequence to identify contributing factors and root causes, framed in a blameless manner focused on systems and processes rather than individuals.
Analyzes the extracted event sequence to assess customer impact, including affected users, duration, severity, and business consequences.
Merges the event timeline, contributing factors, and customer impact analyses into a cohesive blameless post-mortem report, including a list of concrete action items.
